name: QiYi 3x3 Mirror S
description: The QiYi 3x3 Mirror S is a fun twist on the classic 3x3. Instead of using colors, it features shiny brushed stickers in blue, gold, or silver that make the whole cube pop. It solves just like a normal cube, but the pieces are all different sizes, so it changes shape as you mix it up. It’s smooth, flashy, and super satisfying to solve.
